mapper.select:
select pd.KEY_ as definitionKey, count(pd.KEY_) as num
GROUP BY pd.KEY_
select pd.KEY_ as category, exe.BUSINESS_KEY_ as businessKey, task.ID_ as taskId, task.NAME_ as taskName, task.PROC_INST_ID_ as processInstanceId

select inst.PROC_DEF_KEY_ as definitionKey, count(distinct inst.BUSINESS_KEY_) as num
GROUP BY inst.PROC_DEF_KEY_
mapper.sql:
FROM act_hi_taskinst task join act_hi_procinst inst on task.PROC_INST_ID_=inst.ID_ join act_ru_identitylink link on task.ID_ = link.TASK_ID_
inst.END_TIME_ is null
AND (inst.START_USER_ID_=#{userId} or task.ASSIGNEE_=#{userId})
AND inst.PROC_DEF_KEY_ = #{category}
